svg.title: Pre-post-mortem: imagine the change already failed, then work back
svg.desc: A risky change, such as a production write, a schema migration, a destructive script or a run against a live external system, goes to the pre-post-mortem agent, which runs on opus, or to the pre-post-mortem command, which the current session runs on its own work. Both imagine the change has already failed, trace each cause to what it causes next, weeks out, and what it leaves behind, months out, name three ways the analysis is incomplete, attack the analysis and revise it, and end with WATCH FOR THIS ONE: the risk most likely dismissed or found too late. The agent also ranks the causes, turns them into mitigations and gives a go or no-go.

g.text: or found too late, and why

svg.text: green: the analysis moves on · amber: revise, and the closing warning · white: the agent and its model · oval = model, rectangle = agent or step
